meta.title: Wetherspoons Sheffield: Pubs, menus and prices guide
meta.description: Compare Wetherspoons Sheffield pubs across the city centre, Hillsborough and Woodseats, with menu guidance and price checks to help you choose.

intro: This guide covers {pubCount} open Wetherspoons pubs in Sheffield across {areaCount} areas: City Centre, Hillsborough and Woodseats. Every pub works from the national [Wetherspoons menu](/), but prices are set locally. Use it to choose a pub, understand how local pricing works and plan around typical breakfast service and club days. The national menu includes traditional breakfast, burgers, curries, fish and chips, and pizza, but check your chosen pub for current availability. SpoonsMenu is an independent guide.
quickAnswer: There are {pubCount} open Wetherspoons pubs listed in Sheffield: The Bankers Draft and The Roebuck in City Centre, The Rawson Spring in Hillsborough, and The Woodseats Palace in Woodseats. Choose the area that suits your visit, then compare the current menu prices at the individual pubs. The menu is broadly shared nationally, but prices vary by location.

areas.text: The Bankers Draft and The Roebuck are the listed Wetherspoons choices in City Centre. The former is on Market Place; the latter is on Charles Street. They suit visitors who want a central option and a choice of pubs to compare before deciding where to eat.

The Rawson Spring is the listed Wetherspoons pub in Hillsborough, on Langsett Road. It suits anyone choosing Hillsborough as their preferred area for a meal. Check its current menu and prices rather than assuming they match the City Centre pubs.

The Woodseats Palace is the listed Wetherspoons pub in Woodseats, on Chesterfield Road. It suits visitors who would rather eat in Woodseats than choose a City Centre pub. For a useful comparison, check the price of the same meal at each location you are considering.

pricing:
Wetherspoons menu prices in Sheffield vary by pub, even though the menu is broadly the same nationally. Traditional [breakfast](/breakfast-menu), [burgers](/burgers), curries, fish and chips, and pizza are useful starting points when comparing what to order, subject to local availability.

Location can make a difference: city centre pubs often charge more than suburban pubs. That is a general pattern, not a confirmed price ranking for these Sheffield locations, so do not assume either central pub costs more for every dish.

Check the current menu for your chosen pub, using the Wetherspoon app or asking at the bar to confirm the exact price before ordering. Any guide price should be treated as typical rather than fixed.
breakfastAndClubs:
Breakfast at Wetherspoons is typically served from eight in the morning until noon, so that is the general window to plan around in Sheffield. Confirm service times with your chosen pub rather than treating the national pattern as a local promise.

[Curry Club](/curry-club) traditionally runs on Thursday and [Steak Club](/steak-club) on Tuesday at participating pubs. Check participation, the current club menu and typical prices before making a special visit. If you are choosing between breakfast and a later meal, use the local menu to confirm what will be available when you intend to order.
